ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District; B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District; B1-5,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-2, Community Shopping District; B3-5, Community
Shopping District; and C2-1, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 10-E and Map No. 12-E in the area bound by:

       the alley next north of and parallel to East 47th Street; the alley next west of and parallel
       to South Vincennes Avenue; a line 125.2 feet south of and parallel to East 46th Place;
       South Vincennes Avenue; a line 95 feet south of and parallel to East 46th Place; the alley
       next east of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel
       to East 47th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South St. Lawrence Avenue; a
       line 120 feet north of and parallel to East 47th Street; East 47th Street; South Vincennes
       Avenue; a line 100 feet south of and parallel to East 47th Street; a line 300 feet east of
       and parallel to South Dr. Martin Luther King Drive, East 47th Street; and a line 200 feet
       east of and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to South Dr. Martin Luther King
       Drive,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.



                                                             ____________________________
                                                             Pat Dowell
                                                             Alderman, 3rd Ward




Common Address:
436-558 E. 47th Street
431-451 E. 47th Street
